description: This file defines the 'Layout' class in the Kivy framework, including methods for managing widget layout, size hints, and constraints. It also includes detailed comments and documentation about layout behavior and properties.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: An abstract base class for all layout widgets in Kivy, providing mechanisms for adding/removing widgets and layout hint calculations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Layout object, setting up a trigger for layout updates.

methods.name: do_layout
methods.description: Abstract method to perform layout; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the layout and binds layout update triggers to its size and size hint properties.

methods.name: remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the layout and unbinds layout update triggers from its properties.

methods.name: layout_hint_with_bounds
methods.description: Computes and adjusts size hints for child widgets based on constraints and available space.
